items.question: How fresh is the coffee when it arrives?
items.answer: It ships the day it is roasted and usually arrives within two days — right when the beans hit their peak.

items.question: Do you ship outside Belgium?
items.answer: Yes, everywhere in the EU. Shipping is free on subscriptions and on orders over €35.

items.question: Whole bean or ground?
items.answer: Both. Pick your grind at checkout; we grind seconds before sealing the bag.
